otherNightReminder: The Vigormortis chooses a player. :reminder: If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk. :reminder: :reminder:

en.name: Vigormortis
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbour. [−1 Outsider]
en.flavor: All doors are one door. All keys are one key. All cups are one cup, but whosoever drinketh of the water that I give shall never thirst, but the water shall be in him a well springing up into everlasting life.

zh.name: 亡骨魔
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。被你杀死的爪牙保留他的能力，且与他邻近的两名镇民之一中毒。[-1外来者]
